body:
Priya M: Heads-up: running a 30m hands-on drop-in for four mid-market accounts next Wed to fast-track onboarding tickets & surface renewal risks. Need volunteer hosts+backup.
Evan J: I can host one 30m slot. Prefer 9am PT (works for EMEA if we record).
Rosa K: I can cover the second slot at 12pm PT. Happy to take renewal-risk Qs.
Jordan T: Ill be out Wed but can do backup Fri 10am PT. Can someone capture meeting actions in the customer tracker?
Priya M: Good point Jordan. CS-intake-bot can open a follow-up ticket per account if we ask it to. @CS-intake-bot please pre-seed tickets for these accounts.
CS-intake-bot: Tickets created (4) in /customer-success/tracker with tag "drop-in-1747009999".
Priya M: Poll options: Wed 9am PT, Wed 12pm PT, Fri 10am PT (backup). React :one: :two: :three: or drop alt.
Evan J: :one:
Rosa K: :two:
Jordan T: :three:
ops-bot: Recording enabled for the chosen slot. Reminder scheduled 30m prior.
Priya M: Looks like split, but we need both Wed slots to cover multiple timezones. Final plan: Wed 9am PT (Evan host) + Wed 12pm PT (Rosa host). Cap each slot at 10 attendees, record, and require customers to bring 1 example prompt + failing API call if applicable.
Evan J: I'll prepare a 1-sheet "diagnostics checklist" and a quick demo of KV cache warmup. Will drop in the shared drive by Tue EOD.
Rosa K: I'll prep a short renewal-risk checklist (4 signals) and mitigation playbook.
Jordan T: I'll be backup for action capture. Please ping me if anything spikes.
Priya M: Invite blurb draft: "Join our 30m hands-on drop-in for onboarding triage & renewal signal review. Bring an example prompt or a failing request. We'll record and create follow-up tickets for action items." Anyone edit?
Evan J: Add "Well surface immediate quick wins that customers can apply within 24-48h."
Rosa K: +1. Also add "If you cannot attend, submit a short note in the invite with your primary blocker."
Priya M: Done. Ops-bot, enable recording + attach tracker tag to invite.
ops-bot: Recording + tracker tag attached. Calendar invites sent to customers and SSO contacts.
Priya M: Post-session asks: hosts to drop 3-slide summary + attach the 4 tickets. We'll send a 1-question feedback form (Y/N if session helped) within 2 hours.
Jordan T: Quick ask: can feedback results populate the renewal-risk field in the tracker automatically?
CS-intake-bot: Feedback form responses will be appended to the tracker notes.
Priya M: Thanks team. If any conflicts, flag by Tue 10am PT so we can swap hosts. :thumbsup:
